messages:
Priya (PM): Quick sync — need to lock interop cadence + dependency wiring for QueryRouter v2. Major deps: runtime KV prefetch, infra reserved pools, security perf review. Need owners + dates.
Carlos (Eng): +1. Client-side version skew risk if we change routing semantics. Who owns compatibility tests?
Maya (Runtime): Runtime can ship KV prefetch prototype by 2024-04-14. That gives a perf baseline. Need infra to provision canary pools and a stable model snapshot to test against.
Jon (Infra): Infra can stand up 2 reserved pools for canary on 2024-04-10. Need expected RPS and target qps per instance. Also need the terraform snippet for the pool config.
Aisha (Security): Security needs a surface-area doc and threat-model checklist by 2024-04-07. If this touches customer keys or KMS, escalate to KMS team — that adds 1 week.
Kara (TPM): Can we define clear acceptance criteria? Without that infra can't size correctly and security won't sign off.
Priya (PM): Proposed acceptance criteria (short):
- End-to-end p95 latency <= 500ms on canary traffic
- No increase in error rate >0.2% over baseline
- KV prefetch hit rate >= 60% for representative workload
- Security sign-off on threat model + crypto usage
- Rollback plan with automatic fallback to router v1
Carlos (Eng): Ok. For tests: we will add a compatibility harness in CI and a nightly job that replays production traces. Owner: @Carlos. ETA: 2024-04-12.
Maya (Runtime): For perf harness, I’ll need a per-route traffic mix and a model snapshot id. If you give the snapshot I can run microbenchmarks and share kernel traces.
Jon (Infra): Terraform snippet we’ll use (placeholder):
```hcl
resource "redwood_pool" "query_v2_canary" {
  count = 2
  gpu_type = "a100"
  reserved = true
  min_instances = 4
  max_instances = 16
}
```
Share exact min/max after we agree expected qps.
Aisha (Security): A few quick blockers: any addition of prefix caching changes data residency semantics? Also, KV cache must not persist customer plaintext keys. Please add these to the threat doc.
Priya (PM): Noted. KV cache will be in-memory only, TTL <= 10m, no persisted keys. Add to doc.
Kara (TPM): Sequencing proposal:
1) Security threat doc + acceptance criteria (due 4/07) — Aisha
2) Infra canary pools (provision) (ready 4/10) — Jon
3) Runtime KV prefetch + harness (ready 4/14) — Maya
4) CI compatibility + trace replay (ready 4/12) — Carlos
5) Canary run and metrics review (4/15 - 4/18) — cross-team
6) Rollout plan and SLA signoff (by 4/22) — Priya/Kara
Priya (PM): If any step slips by >3 days we fallback to scoped rollout (5% traffic) and extend observation window.
Carlos (Eng): One more ask: need a perf budget per token and p95 tail targets to tune batching. Can runtime publish expected token/sec per GPU?
Maya (Runtime): Rough numbers: a100-80gb: ~600 tok/s for base model, optimized kernel can push ~900 tok/s under continuous batching. Will publish an official table by 4/11.
Jon (Infra): Also callout: prewarm strategy — we can schedule prewarm wave 30 minutes before canary ramp. That needs an abort hook in case metrics deviate. Who owns abort?
Kara (TPM): Abort owned by oncall rotation + runtime oncall. Kara to add abort checklist and alert thresholds to runbook.
Aisha (Security): Small item: please add a test that validates KMS access patterns using a mock KMS — we can run that in CI.
Priya (PM): Good. Let's capture action items:
- Aisha: threat model & checklist (due 2024-04-07)
- Jon: provision 2 canary pools + terraform snippet (ready 2024-04-10)
- Carlos: CI compatibility harness + trace replay job (ready 2024-04-12)
- Maya: KV prefetch impl + perf table (ready 2024-04-14 & perf table by 2024-04-11)
- Kara/Priya: rollout + abort playbook + SLA signoff (ready 2024-04-22)
Please reply in-thread if dates are wrong. If no objections by EOD tomorrow we lock the sequence and schedule a 30-minute handoff on 2024-04-08. :calendar: :rocket:
Carlos (Eng): Dates acknowledged. Might push trace replay to 4/13 depending on dataset prep. I’ll update if so.
Maya (Runtime): Ack. I’ll start the perf suite and post kernel logs to the shared folder.
Jon (Infra): Ack. I’ll drop the terraform PR and tag @Carlos for sizing.
Aisha (Security): Ack. I’ll share a short template for the threat doc in 24h.
Kara (TPM): Scheduling 30m 2024-04-08 and will send calendar invite.
Priya (PM): Thanks all — will consolidate this into the initiative checklist and link in the product plan. :thumbsup:
